title: Paper jam
symptom: Printer stopped with a paper jam message
user_description: The printer stopped halfway and says there's a paper jam. I can see some paper sticking out.

options.text: Pull the paper out as fast as possible in any direction
options.why: Pulling hard or against the paper path can tear the paper and leave scraps inside, or damage the rollers.

options.text: Keep pressing Print until it goes through
options.why: Adds more paper into a jammed printer and can make the jam much worse.

options.text: Follow the on-screen instructions, open the access panels and gently remove the paper along its path, checking no scraps remain
options.why: Removing paper gently in the direction it travels avoids tearing it. Leftover scraps cause repeat jams, so check carefully.
A paper jam is a physical problem. A driver cannot fix paper stuck inside the printer.

hints: Is a paper jam a software problem or a physical one?
In which direction does the paper normally travel?
real_world_tip: Look for small torn pieces. Most repeat jams come from a tiny scrap left behind.
